prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the best one for you depends on your goals, budget, industry, and the types of marketing you need (SEO, paid media, branding, B2B demand gen, creative, etc.). 

If you want a quick starting point:
- Blue Corona (Gaithersburg) is a well-known Maryland-based digital marketing agency with strong data/ROI focus and lots of case studies.
- Beyond that, the right fit will depend on the factors below.

To help you pick the best agency, tell me or consider:
- What’s your primary goal? (lead gen, sales, brand awareness, app installs, etc.)
- What channels matter most? (SEO, PPC, social, content, email, creative/branding)
- Industry or audience (B2B, healthcare, real estate, e‑commerce, local customers)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget
- Timeline and KPIs (3 months, 6 months, revenue targets, MQLs, etc.)
- Preferred engagement type (project, hourly retainer, full-service)

How I can help next:
- If you give the details above, I’ll shortlist 4–6 Maryland agencies that match your needs (with specialties, estimated pricing range, and pros/cons).
- Or I can give an RFP template and a checklist to evaluate agencies (questions to ask, what to look for in case studies/references).

Which option do you want?
